title: SAML assertion KMS unwrap failure allowed transient tenant-binding mismatch in Private control plane (hotpatch required)
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Summary: Multiple Private customers reported unexpected cross-tenant listing and missing audit events after a routine KMS key rotation. Root cause is a race in the Private agent's SAML assertion unwrapping path: when KMS rotation and assertion processing coincide, the agent sometimes accepts an assertion unwrapped with a previous envelope but attaches a stale tenant-binding claim (tenant_id) to the session. The control plane accepted the session because it validated the envelope unwrap but did not assert the key-id/assertion-meta binding atomically. Additionally, the audit aggregator discarded several envelope-chunked events that referenced the rotated KMS envelope ID, causing gaps in audit logs for impacted sessions.
comments: 2026-03-11 08:42 - customer escalations: two Private customers (EU-prod-17, US-onprem-3) reported seeing resources from another tenant in the web console; both on private control plane versions < 2026.02.8.

2026-03-11 09:15 - triage call (oncall, security, eng-leads): reproduced locally by simulating concurrent KMS key rotation + SAML assertion delivery. Observed unwrap returning payload with claims matched to previous key version.

2026-03-11 11:02 - mitigation: coordinated immediate mitigation for affected customers: pinned KMS key to previous key version and disabled automated rotation in control plane config to stop window-infections while hotpatch is prepared.

2026-03-11 13:40 - code discovery: agent path 'sso/assertion_unwrap.go' was missing an explicit validation step: verify assertion's 'key_id' header matches KMS envelope metadata returned by UnwrapResponse. Added TTL check for 'issued_at' and 'not_before' to avoid accepting stale assertions.
2026-03-11 16:05 - hotfix PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/8342 (adds atomic key-id binding check and assertion freshness enforcement).
2026-03-11 17:20 - hotpatch build and smoke: built agent v0.59.3-hotfix image and deployed to one customer staging cluster; run e2e SAML rotation test harness (internal) — pass.

2026-03-12 02:01 - applied hotpatch to affected customers' control planes during maintenance window: rolled agent to v0.59.3-hotfix and restarted sso-proxy; observed no further cross-tenant session creation.

2026-03-12 09:30 - audit re-ingestion: audit-aggregator patch to accept legacy envelope IDs during reprocessing opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/audit-aggregator/pull/219 (replay script to recover discarded events).
2026-03-12 11:10 - postmortem work started: collecting traces, assertion samples, and KMS rotation timestamps for affected clusters and customers to build a timeline for the security postmortem.

Next steps assigned: create end-to-end regression tests for SAML KMS rotation path, add telemetry to detect key-id/assertion mismatches, schedule security review, and notify customers with incident summary and mitigation details.
